name: Sort
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Sort node to organize lists of items in a desired ordering, or generate a random selection

parameters.name: Simple
parameters.description: Performs an ascending or descending sort using the selected fields
options: Use the Add Field To Sort By button to input the Field Name
Select whether to use Ascending or Descending order

parameters.name: Simple options
parameters.description: When you select Simple as the Type, you have the option to Disable Dot Notation. By default, n8n enables dot notation to reference child fields in the format parent.child. Use this option to disable dot notation (turned on) or to continue using dot (turned off)

parameters.name: Random
parameters.description: Creates a random order in the list

parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: Input custom JavaScript code to perform the sort operation. This is a good option if a simple sort won't meet your needs

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of sorting to perform

parameters.name: sortFieldsUi
parameters.description: The fields of the input items to sort by

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Javascript code to determine the order of any two items

options.name: disableDotNotation
options.description: Whether to disallow referencing child fields using `parent.child` in the field name
